reviews.text: Definitely found our new groomer for our kids. The care and effort taken was amazing.
Puppy and kitten’s first grooming experience. Calm happy energy made the experience positive for my critters. Definitely recommend
I’ve been going to her for 2 years regularly now and she’s the best! She’s always very gentle and sweet to my puppy.

Janice is an amazing person. She works very well with my dog and is very passionate and caring about her job. I would reccomend her to everyone. She is very flexible and accommodates customers. Hands down a very long term customer. Best customer service.

Highly recommend Janice! She did a stunning lion cut on my shy Ragdoll. My cat is normally terrified of new people, but she returned home happy, relaxed, and playful. It’s clear Janice has a gentle touch and truly knows how to handle nervous pets. 10/10, will definitely be back!

PawMazing studio has been my top groomer since day 1 I had my 2 ragdolls. She has done a wonderful job with bathing and grooming. She has presents for my cats from time to time very heart warming. She is also very reachable. Love to bring my cats to her even it is quite a distance for myself from Poco area.
My dog was groomed so beautifully here! I’m super happy with the result. Highly, highly recommend — we’ll definitely be back next time!
Best hair cut Gobi ever gotten, we are very happy with the result, highly recommended!
First haircut for our puppy looks so great
Janis is amazing with Theo! Theo has high anxiety for simple nail trimming, and Janis is super patient with him and she’s always accommodating with her schedule.
Booked a Scrub & Fluff for the first time! Jan was very nice and caring. I will be a returning customer. Great neighbourhood gem!
Amazing job, our dog looks great!  Pickles doesn’t like getting her hair cut, but you wouldn’t know it, she came out happy and looking perfect 😃. …

Pawmazing Studio is truly amazing! They take such great care of my dog, Penny, always showing patience and respect for her special needs. It’s clear that they genuinely love and understand animals, creating a welcoming and humanized environment. I always feel at ease knowing she’s in good hands. Highly recommend!
The picture is a before and after her full groom.
Janice did an amazing job in grooming my dog. I’m very happy with her work!

I’m giving a five star rating to Janice, owner of PawMazing Studio. My groomer for my Shorkiepoo, Kirby. She did a great job in taming and making my dog look beautiful. I will surely recommend her good skills to anyone. Thank you so much for your service!
Super friendly and professional!! Got rid of all the fleas on my cat
Thank you so much. I hope to meet your other baby soon 🥰 …
She did a great job with our Meeko! Would come back again. It’s located in her house and we do pick up/drop off at the back entrance!

Janis is absolutely amazing.  It is very clear how much she love dogs and how much the dogs trust and love her.  She is kind, gentle and incredibly good at her job.  We are so grateful we found Janis!!!

I recently took my dog Sammy to Pawmazing for grooming, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! Was an excellent job, and Sammy looks absolutely beautiful. The work was very professional, and the outcome was stunning.
The facilities are warm and welcoming, and there is an adorable kitty receptionist who adds a lovely touch to the place. I highly recommend Pawmazing. Sammy loved it, and it’s clear that it’s a wonderful place for our little fluffy friends.

Thank you for being so patient with our puppy's first groom! She was nervous at first but you really brought her out of her shell and made her so comfortable with the process. She loved you and looked great!
Beautiful cut on my schnoodle, to get him ready for vacation and insta-worthy posts. Nice to support a local business ❤️and Jan is great.

I had a fantastic experience at PawMazing Studio for my cat's bath. The groomer was incredibly kind and honest, providing helpful and informative advice instead of trying to upsell unnecessary services. Highly recommend!
Excellent service

We are extremely satisfied with the service at this studio especially for my cat, Salmon. My cat Salmon received five-star treatment and was always handled with great professionalism and patience. Janis is particularly noteworthy; she is very knowledgeable and was able to answer all my questions, providing us with many helpful suggestions. Her care for Salmon was exceptional, giving us great peace of mind. We will bring Salmon back here again.
Lovely calm and gentle service for my doggo!
